profile.headline: Software Engineer | Google Certified Data Analyst | MES/SAP/PLM |
profile.summary:
- Develop customized functional designs to map industry-leading practices to the organization’s business 
   requirements
- Experience with web application development using ASP.net Stack with the knowledge Model-View- 
   Controller architecture and utilization of various Design patterns
- Machine Learning and model training experiences in stock predict project and biological gene sequence 
   project
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Self-Motivated & hardworking.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.insights: C#, SQL Stored Procedures and +5 skills

positions.title: Software Developer/Industrial Engineer
positions.description:
-Build and maintain department expense models to calculate direct labor, overhead, and headcount
-Coach, guide, and assist with training of all new process engineer database and computer setting 
-Conduct an in-depth risk analysis to assist with the optimization of control systems and improve production output
-Support the business with resolving production issues by providing critical control knowledge and assistance, where required
-Improve the existing MES system to collect data and analysis the production line performance, equipment uptime, and downtime. Provide valuable results for stakeholder to make driven decisions such as bottleneck founding
-Thorough and meticulous Data Analyst passionate about helping businesses succeed, helped department manager cost variance analysis, using SAP report and database timesheet work orders

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Compile, modify, develop, debug and maintain LabVIEW applications for production line and provide end-user training
- Collaborate with management teams to design efficient, reusable software workflow to improve the business operation efficiency
- Work with the semiconductor wafer process engineering team to analyze and define the requirements of the Manufacture Execution System
- Design, implement and maintain the Manufacturing Execution System using LabVIEW, C#, MSSQL
- Front-end web application development using Javascript, jQuery, Ajax, JSON, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, .Net and Visual Studio
- Document software, including requirements, design, code.

positions.title: Assistant Software Engineer (Intern)
positions.description:
- Helped the engineers to solve the problem in SQL and Java.
- ERP system in a medium-sized company.
